invariants.text: Customer.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Each customer must have a unique email address.
A customer can be searched by name using a partial match on the name field.
Customers can be filtered by email domain, such as 'example.com' or 'gmail.com'.
Creating a new customer fails if the email address already exists in the database.
Updating a customer's email address requires that the new email address is unique across all customers.
Deleting a customer removes the customer record from the database.
The list of customers returned by a search or filter operation includes only those matching the specified criteria.
